statement: With repeated pairs per person, the SD of a single difference combines between- and within-person variance components from a one-way ANOVA (σ²_b = (MS_b - MS_w)/λ, truncated at zero, λ = (n² - Σm_i²)/((k-1)n)), the bias's variance is (σ²_b·Σm_i² + σ²_w·n)/n² on t(k-1) (or the person-means variance over k when σ²_b is truncated), and the limits' intervals come from Zou's MOVER.
regime: Describe or Predict; persons with more than one pair; not under a survey design
claimed_basis: Bland & Altman 2007 (J Biopharm Stat 17:571); Zou 2013 (Stat Methods Med Res 22:630)

statement: Open noticings must be given their dispositions before the plan's lock under Estimate and Describe (and under an unanswered purpose), or before the held-out rows open under Predict; a disposition recorded after that point would be chosen with the numbers in view, so the triage is refused and each noticing is decided on its own as made after the estimates or held-out scores were seen.
regime: All purposes; gate = plan lock (Estimate, Describe, unanswered) or seal opened (Predict)
decision: Whether 'Confirm all' on the open-noticings triage is accepted
claimed_basis: calm/FOUNDATION §7; UNDERSTANDING_LAYER §7 ruling 1 as re-ruled 2026-10-09 (module docstring); no literature cited

statement: Internal–external cross-validation across survey cycles is summarized by a fixed-effect inverse-variance meta-analysis of each cycle's MSE with a normal 95% interval, which also serves as a valid prediction interval for a new cycle's MSE when cycles' performance is heterogeneous.
regime: internal–external cross-validation across survey cycles (k cycles), heterogeneous performance
claimed_basis: Riley et al. 2016 (BMJ 353:i3140); Higgins, Thompson & Spiegelhalter 2009.

statement: An exclusion rule that reads the outcome (its column, ranges set by it, or any input of a Goldberg screen that is the outcome) selects on the value being explained and biases the estimates, so it is refused in each sensitivity analysis as in the primary.

When the study-design question is unanswered, analyzing the table as an observational study (people observed as they were, not randomized, not sampled by the outcome, not matched) is a safe default under every goal, provided it is stated and listed for confirmation.
regime: any table whose design slot (q:study-design) is unanswered
decision: the study-design slot; which analysis lane runs
claimed_basis: crosswalk disagreement 10 (the design slot); V2X_SEAMS seam guard 6 and recommendation 6

statement: Under prediction with the surveyed-population answer, cross-validated performance estimates population performance only if the folds keep whole PSUs within strata and every loss, calibration and comparison is survey-weighted (design-based cross-validation), while under the sample answer unweighted scores describe the procedure's performance on these rows only.
decision: Fold construction and weighting of prediction scores
claimed_basis: Wieczorek, Guerin & McMahon 2022, Stat 11:e454 (design-based K-fold CV); MODELING_SEQUENCE §0 ruling 13.

statement: Under Predict, each continuous predictor of least squares, ridge and the elastic net enters as a restricted cubic spline (Harrell's knots, placed in each training fold) by default when Riley's sample-size criteria hold for the terms it makes (here 3,916 rows needed for 73 terms at an expected shrinkage of at least 0.9).

Two roles that remove a column from the predictors cannot be settled by values: free text (a category with many labels such as country of birth, ~70 labels, or a text identifier fits the same label count) and survey-design part (a measurement with positive values, or a group code that is a predictor, fits the same); each needs the user's confirmation.
regime: Text columns with many labels; columns read as survey weight, stratum or PSU.
decision: Free-text or design role (left out of the model) vs predictor.
claimed_basis: BLUEPRINT §14.3 (fourth gate: 'a label count read as free text (country of birth has 70)').

statement: When the Newton fit drives a coefficient beyond 20 SDs of its column on the log-hazard scale (or does not converge), the partial likelihood has no finite maximum (monotone likelihood, 'in one of its groups every row has the event, or none does'), so the hazard ratio is infinite and no interval or p-value is reported.
claimed_basis: none stated (survival.py:59: 'a log hazard ratio of 20 per SD is an infinite one')

statement: When the exposure family holds exactly one exposure-role column, the choice of multiplicity method changes no p-value or interval, so the stated multiplicity default moves from the Confirm sweep to For the record.
regime: Estimate or Describe; exactly one column with role exposure
decision: Whether the set_multiplicity default is a Confirm line or For the record
claimed_basis: none stated (the family is every exposure-role column, EstimandSpec.family)

statement: Views that never use the outcome may shape the representation (transforms, knots, filters, imputation rules), and under inference steps learned without the outcome may be fit on the full analysis sample; views that use the outcome may only add candidates to a declared search under prediction (never prune it) and under inference are reported, not acted on, unless a declared selection-aware method carries them.
regime: exploration (First look and Explore) across purposes
decision: what an exploration thread may feed (enforced at registration)
claimed_basis: Harrell RMS 4.7; Baillie 2022; Gelman & Loken 2013; Belloni et al. 2014; Ambroise & McLachlan 2002

statement: Under prediction, steps that never use the outcome (scaling, PCA loadings, median imputation) must be fit inside each training fold, but screening predictors by their univariate association with the outcome may be done once on all rows before cross-validation without biasing the error estimate, because the screen uses only each predictor's marginal association.
regime: prediction with many candidate predictors, internal validation

statement: In a randomized trial the primary analysis is per protocol: only participants who received the assigned treatment as planned, analyzed in that arm, because excluding non-adherers removes noise while the comparison stays protected by randomization.
